activeWorkPacket.name: Read Routing & Activation Failure Matrix
activeWorkPacket.businessGoal: Ensure every official read obeys the authoritative CURRENT generation and activation fails closed under invalid, stale, revoked, duplicate, concurrent, or interrupted conditions.
closedGates: two consecutive governed production generation activations with Candidate=Oracle=CURRENT overlay
openGates: additional checkpoint invalidation / transaction interruption cases if required
activeWorkPacket.nextAction: Define and verify CURRENT live-tail semantics plus a shared Worker/Activation cutover lock before closing the concurrency gate.

branchPolicy.workingRule: Use short-lived work-packet branches. Merge a database-verified bounded slice to main before starting the next substantial slice when its evidence boundary is explicit.
branchPolicy.analysisRule: LLMs must use branch.topology.json plus live GitHub compare results before merge/delete/revival decisions.

forbiddenVolatileMarkers: uncited claims that a whole work packet is complete
